item.title: Match Report: Walsall Women 3-1 AFC Telford United
item.description: Walsall Women ran out 3-1 winners against AFC Telford United Ladies in a relatively comfortable performance at Dales Lane on Sunday afternoon. Mia Fellows’ first half brace put the Saddlers two in front, until Abi Beady struck soon after the restart. However, Phoebe Smith’s late header wrapped up the win as they returned to winning ways in the West Midlands Regional Women’s Football League Division One. item.description: Head Coach Mat Sadler reflected on the defeat to MK Dons on Monday night with a sense of disappointment as his side fell to a 2-0 loss at the Pallet-Track Bescot Stadium. item.title: Willis satisfied with gritty performance in Telford victory
item.description: Walsall Women Head Coach Matt Willis was satisfied with his side’s gritty performance in their 3-1 win over AFC Telford United at Dales Lane. Mia Fellows’ brace gave the Saddlers an early lead, which was halved by Abi Beady in the second half, before Phoebe Smith nodded in the third to relieve any pressure on the Black Country outfit. item.title: Smith proud of team for extending unbeaten run
item.description: Walsall Women captain Phoebe Smith took pride in her side’s professional performance in their 3-1 win over AFC Telford United Women on Sunday afternoon.
